title: MENRE forest ranger shot dead beside the highway in Sitio Golf, Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A gunman on a motorcycle shot Ebrahim Sampayan Abdullah, 59, a forest ranger of the BARMM Ministry of Environment, Natural Resources and Energy assigned to Lanao del Sur, as he was about to board his motorbike beside the highway in Sitio Golf, Barangay Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 10:40 a.m. on Thursday, 26 November 2026. He died at the scene. Witnesses named the gunman as a certain “Uto Kusain”, who fled; police launched a hot pursuit and had not established a motive.

title: 3 hurt as a rido settlement dialogue turns to an explosion and gunfire in Sambolawan, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A dialogue in Barangay Sambolawan, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Thursday, 26 November 2026, meant to settle a long-running family feud between two MILF groups ended in a fistfight, then an explosion and successive gunshots. Pahamudin Mundas, 37, and Salman Mundas, 39, of Barangay Limbo, and Saipudin Usman of Barangay Macaguiling, members of the BIAF Inner Guard 19th Brigade, were wounded and taken to the Cotabato Sanitarium and General Hospital. Police launched a manhunt for the group of a Commander Jun Barangay.
